summary: Facebook feed post, light mode. Long-pressing Like shows a grey press highlight. A white pill tray with 7 animated reactions then springs up above the action row (167 ms, ~6% overshoot), while the row is replaced by helper text. Tapping a reaction shows its name label. On release the tray and the other emojis drop away in ~67 ms. The chosen emoji then follows a fixed 333 ms arc: it pops to 1.08x, rises 85 pt and swoops left and down to a fixed point near (88, 652) pt, shrinking to nothing. The button label and count swap instantly. The recording runs the same cycle for Love, Care, Haha, Wow, Sad and Angry, each followed by an un-react tap.
trigger: Long-press Like button. The tray appears 50-133 ms after the press highlight shows, but the real touch-down is probably earlier. Then tap a reaction. Tap the reacted button again to remove the reaction.

animations.notes: Hold before the tray opens varies across the 6 long-presses (133, 67, 50, 83, 83, 83 ms, measured from highlight-on to tray start). So highlight-on is probably not the real touch-down. iOS scroll views delay the highlight. The real long-press threshold is likely ~250-400 ms but cannot be measured.

animations.name: Tray emojis pop in

animations.name: Emoji idle animations inside tray

properties.notes: Each emoji runs its own animated sticker, e.g. Wow blinks (eyes closed ~2.88 s), Haha bobs, and Love pulses at ~3.2-3.3 s. Like, Wow and Sad are still for long stretches.

animations.notes: The animations restart from frame 0 every time the tray opens. Cross-cycle frame difference is about 1-3/255, versus 10-35 within a cycle. The longest hold here is about 1.0 s and no loop repeats inside it, so the loop period is over 1 s and cannot be measured.

keyframe_images.caption: Tray 17 ms in: translucent, low, emojis at ~0.58x; helper text already swapped
Tray/emoji overshoot peak (emojis 1.03x, tray 1.5 pt high)
Touch on Love: 'Love' tooltip appears, emoji not scaled
Release: tray drops/fades, others shrink, heart lifts; button reads 'Love' instantly
Fly-out apex (117 ms): 85 pt above row, 0.9x, drifting left

observations: All six fly-outs share one 333 ms timeline and end at the same point (~88, 652 pt), whatever the starting slot. Horizontal speed scales with distance (Love travels 35 pt, Angry 265 pt), and the apex height and timing (561 pt at 117 ms) are identical. A designer can reuse one motion path and change only P0.
The fly-out end point is not the Like button icon (~20, 716 pt). The emoji shrinks to zero just above the summary row near x ≈ 88 pt.
Text and state changes are all instant cuts with no cross-fades: action row ↔ helper text, the button label, the count text, and the summary icons.
The selected emoji does not grow while touched in this tap-to-select flow. Only the name tooltip appears. The 1.08x pop happens after release.
Tray and emoji entrance share one spring (no stagger). The emojis start at ~0.4x and ~35 pt lower, so they appear to rise out of the action row.
Emoji sticker animations restart from frame 0 on each tray open.
Removing a reaction has no motion beyond the button's highlight fade.
open_questions: Real touch-down time and long-press threshold. There are no touch indicators, and the highlight-to-tray gap varies from 50 to 133 ms, so the highlight is probably delayed by the scroll view.
Emoji idle loop periods are over 1 s. The tray is never held long enough to see a loop repeat.
Whether the tray's first frame is a clip/reveal or a scale from the bottom: only 1-2 frames, partly translucent over a busy photo.
The 'Slide finger across' path (dragging across emojis without lifting) was not exercised, so drag-hover scaling of emojis is unseen.
Possible haptic on tray open (can't be seen in a recording).
One duplicated frame at 2.763 s (identical to 2.747), so the tray-in timing may be off by ~17 ms.
